notes.title: FIX 1.1 [08/03]
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are sorry to hear that you are experiencing bugs at the moment. Our team is doing its best to address the issues. This game represents a lot of pressure, and it's important to know that we are still students at this stage so I hope this will soften your judgment.

We have added an option for the puppet to revive itself when the animator is unfortunately unable to do so. Additional fixes will be coming this week, particularly regarding the placement of the sticks and connection issues.

If you want the least amount of network problems, hosting as the puppet should be the most stable version.
